title: NIGHTMARE.EXE
tagline: 24 hours. No sleep. Something is watching your commits.
description:
Our flagship overnight hackathon, held on Halloween night.

Build anything: web, AI, hardware, games. The only rule is that it must be finished before sunrise. Mentors will walk the halls all night. Some of them are real.

Food, energy drinks, swag and a prize pool for the teams that survive.

title: THE HAUNTED KERNEL
tagline: A capture-the-flag night on Friday the 13th.
description:
Jeopardy-style CTF: web, crypto, forensics, reverse engineering and pwn.

The flags are hidden in a machine that was last booted in 1999. Break in before it wakes up.

title: SÉANCE OF CODE
tagline: Summon an AI that should not exist.
description:
A 36-hour AI buildathon. Build agents, generative art, voice spirits and anything else that talks back.

Workshops on LLMs, RAG and agents on day one.
